references.text: Joshua leads the warriors, the brave fighters, who are referred to here as 'gibborei hechayil' (the mighty men of valor)
Gilgal was the starting point for Israel's military operations after they crossed the Jordan
Gilgal was Israel's main camp where they settled after crossing the Jordan
Joshua leads the entire army out to battle, a similar military mobilization as seen in this verse
Gilgal is mentioned as Joshua's camp where the Gibeonites came seeking peace
The Gibeonites ask for help from Joshua at the camp in Gilgal, which leads to this march out
Moses' encouragement to be strong and courageous in battle, a theme repeated throughout Joshua's military leadership
Gideon is called 'gibbor hechayil' (mighty warrior), the same expression used for Joshua's men
